questions.question: What is the approximate maximum separation measured along the surface of the Earth between two stations communicating by EME?

choices.B: 2,000 miles, if the moon is at apogee
choices.C: 5,000 miles, if the moon is at perigee

questions.question: When scheduling EME contacts, which of these conditions will generally result in the least path loss?

choices.A: When the Moon is at perigee
choices.C: When the Moon is at apogee
choices.D: When the MUF is above 30 MHz

questions.question: In what direction does an electromagnetic wave travel?

choices.C: It depends on the phase angle of the electric field

choices.D: They are 90 degrees out of phase

questions.question: What should be done to continue a long-distance contact when the MUF for that path decreases due to darkness?
